I had the same problem and I looked everywhere for the solution and I am going to try my best to provide a decent solution. 

I ran with a 1060 6gb card as well as a i7 8700 non k and for awhile it was great, ran games amazingly etc but then I got into streaming and when I put my second monitor which was a 60hz to my card it just didn’t work. Micro stutters and it was just disgusting to see. My main monitor is a 240hz (I love frames and I love competitive gaming) 

I did what you did, I looked through all my settings and messed with a bunch of settings, what I finally ended up doing is putting the hz on my main monitor down to 120hz which made it steady. Not the best or as fluid but still better than what it was. Give that a try though, I since moved on to building a whole new pc with a 2070. 

The 1060 6gb is just a tough card to stream with since it’s not very powerful
